editorial:
You know that feeling when a sleepover gets way out of hand? This movie leans into that chaos. Megan and Paige are best friends, and Veronica is the soon-to-be step-sister who gets pulled into the mess. After a birthday party hypnotism goes wrong, they wake up with zero memory of the night before. The fun comes from watching them piece together clues, deal with awkward family stuff, and try to fix whatever happened before anyone finds out. It has a bright, silly energy that works well for a family movie night.

The pacing stays quick, the jokes are easy to follow, and the cast keeps things lively. It is not deep, but it is charming and has enough heart to keep you smiling. Some jokes repeat and a few moments feel rushed, yet the overall vibe is warm and harmless. If you want a light comedy with a mystery twist, this is a good pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the girls finally figure out what happened during the missing hours. The hypnotism made them do silly but harmless things, and the big twist is that Veronica was not trying to ruin the party; she was actually trying to help. They clear up the misunderstanding, make peace with the family, and the birthday ends with everyone laughing together. It wraps up sweetly and leaves you with a happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and silly mystery stories.
